telegram.help:
Commands:
/start — link account
/link — linking help
/status — active tasks
/transcribe [audio_id] [skills…] — transcribe (latest audio if omitted)
/summary [transcript_id] — summarize (pick a skill from buttons)
Send a URL to import
Send audio/voice to upload
